translation.en: A messenger came from the king.
The king sent a messenger.
I handed the letter to the messenger.
I saw the horse of the king's messenger.
The fire flared up.
The scout lit the fire.
The mother cooked on the fire.
The warmth of the fire is gentle.
The slave was freed.
The merchant freed the slave.

translation.bs: Čovjek je bio dobar prema robu.
translation.en: The man treated the servant well.
The servant's hand got tired.
Mercy is beautiful.
The mother loves mercy.
The teacher spoke about mercy.
The trace of mercy is clear.
The saying is clear.
The student wrote a beautiful saying.
The man thought about the saying.
The author of the saying is known.
Guidance is clear.
The man sought guidance.
The student was glad of the guidance.
The road of guidance is clear.
An hour passed.
The traveler waited an hour.
The child slept for one hour.
Half an hour passed.
The food is delicious.
The mother cooked the food.

translation.bs: Gost se zahvalio majci na hrani.
translation.en: The guest thanked the mother for the food.
The smell of the food is pleasant.
The memory is beautiful.
The mother keeps the memory.
Grandfather spoke about the memory.
The day of remembrance is near.
The poor man asks for food.
The merchant helped the poor man.
The child sat with the poor man.
The poor man's house is small.
The interpretation is correct.
The professor explained the interpretation.

translation.bs: Studenti su se razišli u tumačenju.
translation.en: The students differed about the interpretation.
The correctness of the interpretation is important.
Anger tires the heart.
The employee concealed the anger.
The child shouted out of anger.
The moment of anger is short.
The crops drink the rain water.
The farmer watered the crops.
The rain fell on the crops.
The owner of the crops is a farmer.
The years passed quickly.
The grandfather remembered the past years.

translation.bs: Grad se promijenio u posljednjim godinama.
translation.en: The city changed in the last years.
The passing of the years is quick.
The clay is flexible.
The worker carried the clay.
The children played with the clay.
The type of the clay is good.
The horse's neck is strong.
The child touched the cat's neck.
A mark appeared on the neck.
The movement of the neck is easy.
The fool spends the money quickly.
The grandfather advised the fool.
The wise man spoke with the fool.
The speech of the fool is empty.
The dissent between the neighbors stopped.
The judge stopped the dissent.
The teacher warned of dissent.
The reason for the dissent is small.
Dawn came quickly.
The traveler waited for dawn.
The farmer wakes up with dawn.
The light of dawn is beautiful.
Olives are beneficial.
The farmer picked the olives.
I ate the bread with olives.
Olive oil is healthy.
Misery afflicted the village.
People faced misery with patience.
The family lived in misery.
The days of misery are difficult.
The lamp lit up the room.
Grandfather lit the lamp.

translation.bs: Otac je stavio ulje u svjetiljku.
translation.en: The father put oil in the lamp.
The light of the lamp is weak.
Recovery came after a week.
The friends wished the patient a recovery.
The family rejoiced at the recovery.
The speed of the recovery made the doctor happy.
The blossom appeared on the palm tree.
The farmer saw the blossom.
The bird sat on the blossom.
The color of the blossom is white.
The fatigue went away after sleep.
Sleep removed the fatigue.
The worker felt fatigue.
The cause of the fatigue is the long journey.
The speech was long.
The manager delivered the speech.
The students listened to the speech.
The text of the speech is short.
The cold was severe.
The cat hates the cold.
The child trembled from the cold.
The intensity of the cold is great.

translation.bs: Suze su tekle iz njenih očiju.
translation.en: Tears flowed from her eyes.
The mother wiped the child's tears.

translation.bs: Oči su mu se napunile suzama.
translation.en: His eyes filled with tears.
The taste of tears is salty.
The young boy played in the garden.
The mother carried the young boy.
The grandfather gave a gift to the young boy.
The young boy's mother laughed.
The paternal uncle visits the family.

translation.bs: Mladić je sreo amidžu na pijaci.
translation.en: The young man met the paternal uncle in the market.
The girl wrote a letter to the paternal uncle.
The paternal uncle's house is beautiful.
The cover fell from the bed.

translation.bs: Majka je stavila pokrivač na dijete.
translation.en: The mother put a cover on the child.
The child wrapped himself in the cover.
The color of the cover is blue.
